title: Ranch Beekeeper
premise: A long master-apprentice drama on the alfalfa apiary and creek-side extracting flat. Adeng and Azhou are easily confused by looks; the oak smoker goes intact→bellows_burst→reskinned; after the bee truck overturns it must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.

states.prime_hivekeep: Ranch beekeeper Chen Xing around fifty, long lean face, cream protective suit and straw hat, veil flipped onto the brim, hands callused from stings.
states.sting_weary: The same Chen Xing: protective-suit cuff torn, red swollen sting on the neck side, walking slowly propped on the smoker, eyes heavy.
states.deceased: Chen Xing lies still on the apiary cabin plank bed with eyes closed, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_apprentice: Young Adeng: a lean beekeeping apprentice of fourteen or fifteen, amber beeswax button on the hat brim, oversized cream protective suit, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Adeng: a broader-shouldered beekeeper in his twenties, still with the amber beeswax button, suit fitting, steady eyes.

states.intact: An oak smoker with intact bellows leather cup, pale-blue pine smoke from the nozzle, bee patterns carved on the pot.
states.bellows_burst: The same oak smoker with burst leaking bellows leather cup, nozzle caked with tar, bee patterns smoked black.
states.reskinned: The oak smoker fitted with a new leather cup, nozzle cleaned, bee patterns visible again, ready to smoke.

states.intact: A cowhide honey extract daybook recording each hive's strength and extract yield, handwriting neat.
states.honey_stained: The same honey extract daybook soaked through with honey, cover sticky, writing bled.

states.intact: A dark-green migratory bee truck with twelve standard hives fixed in the bed, white bee patterns sprayed on the door.
states.overturned_wrecked: The bee truck overturned on a mud slope; hives scattered and broken, bed twisted, bee patterns buried in mud.

states.young_rival: Young beekeeping hand Azhou whose face closely matches Adeng's, but wearing vermilion rubber gloves and a dark-green vest over the suit, swaggering look.
states.disguised_return: After a change of look Azhou still wears vermilion rubber gloves; vest swapped for matte black, expression deeper.

segments.action: At dusk Chen Xing lifts his veil and walks into the alfalfa apiary, testing a puff from the oak smoker.
A row of five apiary lanterns hangs on the cabin beam; Chen Xing wipes each glass shade clean.
Two hive-opening bronze bells hang under the cabin eaves; Chen Xing taps them lightly, the ring clear.
Chen Xing checks the oak smoker leather cup and bee patterns for leaks.
Chen Xing looks through the alfalfa sea toward dusk at the ranch edge.
The intact oak smoker rests on a hive lid, nozzle catching lantern warm light.
Chen Xing sits on the cabin steps and drinks a sip of cold tea.
Distant cattle bells chime lightly; he puts the veil back on.
Chen Xing opens the cowhide honey extract daybook and records today's colony-strength scores.
He sketches a bar chart of each hive's extract yield in the book.
Chen Xing closes the honey extract daybook and tucks it back into the cabin drawer.
Pale-blue pine smoke from the oak smoker sweeps his profile.
He tears a scrap of wax paper and wipes sticky honey from his gloves.
On the creek extracting flat at dawn, Chen Xing greets the approaching dark-green bee truck.
Young Adeng jumps down from the bee truck; the amber beeswax button on his hat brim shines in morning light.
Chen Xing points to the three frame number tags on the front row and teaches Adeng to read A1 through A3.
Adeng crouches by the creek and curiously touches the extractor crank.
Chen Xing tells Adeng the hive-opening bronze bells must ring twice before lids come off.
Adeng looks back at the intact bee truck, eyes full of longing.
Purple alfalfa sways; they walk toward the alfalfa apiary.
In the tool-shed narrow lane, Azhou in vermilion rubber gloves glances back from veil shadows.

segments.action: When spring flowers first open, Chen Xing patrols hives in the alfalfa day after day.
Another rainy night, he wraps his protective suit tight beside the oak smoker.
At high summer noon colonies grow restless; he rotates cooling sprays.
In autumn fog, lantern light struggles through the honey scent.
On New Year's Eve Chen Xing alone fills the honey extract daybook to the last page.
At spring start he rechecks queen excluders and keeps rearing queens.
Before rainy season Chen Xing reinforces ant-proof hive stands.
After Frost's Descent he adds a small bag of white sugar in a cabin corner.
Another year before migration he checks colony strength hive by hive.
On a snow night with work stopped, Chen Xing keeps only one lantern until dawn.
After Awakening of Insects he resets dried foundation sheets.
Around Qingming he clears weeds at the old migration camp entrance.
Chen Xing changes the veil and shakes off stuck bee wings.
He checks the extractor gears and drips edible oil.
He lifts the intact oak smoker again and gives three short puffs.
Water sounds rise from the creek; he looks up to listen.
Chen Xing drops waste wax scrap into an iron bucket and lids it.
At noon rest he drinks tea in the cabin; tea smoke curls past the straw hat.
In the afternoon he goes out again to sugar-feed weak colonies.
At sunset he seals hives and locks the tool shed.
At daybreak Chen Xing patrols the creek extracting flat; the bee truck still sits by the concrete pier.
He crouches to check whether the bee truck bed hive straps are loose.
On the front row, those three frame number tags still hang in place.
An ash-gray trailer drives along the ranch road, body wide and flat, no bee patterns.
Chen Xing stands on the extracting flat and logs foundation sheets dampened overnight.
He retightens the bee truck hooks.
A ranch dog barks once afar; morning fog begins to lift.
At nightfall Chen Xing returns to the alfalfa apiary and opens the honey-stained honey extract daybook.

segments.action: An orange-red pickup rolls onto the creek extracting flat—nothing like the already-overturned bee truck.
A ranch veterinarian in a khaki hat and gray-green work clothes walks onto the extracting flat and talks shoulder to shoulder with Chen Xing; their builds are alike.
The veterinarian points at the orange-red pickup and explains the temporary hive-haul plan.
The pickup drives off; Chen Xing alone watches it leave the extracting flat.
He rehangs the frame number tags straight and walks back to the apiary.
Intern beekeeper Xiao He in a light-yellow headscarf arrives in the tool-shed narrow lane; at a glance she looks somewhat like young Adeng.
Xiao He tries tying a veil, but Chen Xing shakes his head—she is not Adeng after all.
Xiao He bows her head and steps back; only queen-excluder shadows remain in the lane.
Years later at dusk, Chen Xing with torn cuff and swollen neck leans on the smoker under the old migration camp.
